correctness.rationale: Heriban--Tušek give the exact determinant and the inverse of the spectral coordinate. Exact factorization shows characteristic zero order equals the quadratic-root multiplicity because the inverse map has nonzero derivative at every admissible root. A finite-rank Krein contour-trace identity identifies determinant zero order with algebraic multiplicity. Corollary 3.7 then gives the exact geometric-multiplicity-two family, proving the semisimple/defective dichotomy. Symbolic and numerical checks reproduce the discriminant, ranks and Puiseux coefficient.
